main_body: deciduous tree with spherical green canopy and brown trunk
top_band: light/mid green upper canopy dome, rows 1-14
evidence: Organic tree shows upper canopy lit from above (rows 1-14), front/underside canopy in deeper shade (rows 15-30) overhanging the vertical trunk (rows 31-46).

style.evidence: While the canopy has multiple green shades, it reads as a smooth pillow-shaded ball with a dark solid outline and a stiff, straight, geometric cylinder trunk with a flat horizontal bottom edge, lacking the organic individual leaf clusters, internal branch glimpses, and splayed roots of the Beodeul tree references.
